notes.title: 100 Rooms Major Release
notes.notes: Today marks a big day for us. This will be the first update and full release of 100 Rooms! As we never want to be the people who leave games in  "Early Access Abyss" I have decided to update and put 100 Rooms in full launch. Keep an eye out as there may be fore updates in the future.
